title: The Manager — EN/JA/ZH (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational absurdist 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Japanese Chinese language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The manager stands in the technical area
The precise limits of what a manager can actually do
Once the whistle goes

[Verse 2 — 日本語]
監督には計画があった [The manager had a plan]
計画は優れていた [The plan was excellent]
計画はほとんどのことを考慮していた [The plan accounted for most things]
左バックは考慮されていなかった [It did not account for the left back]
プレーが始まった瞬間から [From the moment play began]
まったく異なる計画を持っていた [Having a completely different plan]

[Chorus — English]
The manager says — this is what we trained for, stick to the shape
The players say — yes gaffer
And then do what the game requires
Which is frequently not the shape

[Bridge — 中文]
查斯说 — 教练是足球中最乐观的人 [Chas said — the manager is the most optimistic person in football]
他们相信，在每个赛季开始时 [They believe, at the start of every season]
球员们这次会做 [That this time the players will do]
在训练中讨论过的事情 [Exactly what was discussed in training]
查斯说 — 在这个游戏的历史上，这从未发生过一次 [Chas said — this has never happened once in the history of the game]

[Verse 3 — English]
The plan met reality — and one of them blinked

[Outro — EN/JA/ZH]
The manager
監督 [The manager]
教练 [The manager]
That's my boy
